description: This file defines a class 'FirebaseAnalyticsHelper' that implements an 'AnalyticsHelper' interface. The class provides functionality to log analytics events to Firebase Analytics by accepting an 'AnalyticsEvent' object and passing its data to Firebase with proper key/value truncation.

classes.name: FirebaseAnalyticsHelper
classes.description: Implementation of `AnalyticsHelper` which logs events to a Firebase backend.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs an analytics event to Firebase Analytics, truncating keys and values to meet Firebase parameter length limits.
